question: For 70 official_pdf_fill families whose named form title matched no filename in the mounted Master Library, is the artifact actually absent - and if not absent, where is it held?
answer: A filename miss was mostly not absence. 46 of the 70 families are fully or partly held already: under a different filename, under a form number instead of a title, at a later revision, inside a combined packet PDF, as a page range in a larger document, in the Nationwide Record Clearing inventory rather than the Master Library, or as a human source return. 16 need a genuine fetch and now carry an established identity. 4 are wrongly modelled as form-based and must be composed from the authority. 1 is not a packet at all. 3 cannot be treated until a named legal question is answered.
method: Every named form was searched by form number, by title words, by issuing agency and by statutory section against: the mounted Master Library corpus, data/rcap-all50/local-source-corpus-index.json (329 indexed PDFs, recorded titles and form numbers), data/rcap-all50/nationwide-source-inventory.json (the committed index of private/Nationwide Record Clearing), data/rcap-grade-a/official-source-registry.json, data/rcap-grade-a/route-obligation-census-v1/source-custody-reconciliation.json, the source-acquisition receipts and URL promotion candidates under data/rcap-grade-a/, the human source returns under data/rcap-grade-a/source-verification/, and the state packs under src/lib/rcap/state-packs/.

Where a candidate was reachable on disk its bytes were read with pdftotext and the printed form number, title and revision were used as the identity evidence. Sixteen documents were confirmed that way, including two multi-document bundles whose page ranges were mapped.

Where a candidate is recorded in the Nationwide inventory but the folder is not mounted in this container, identity is marked inferred_requires_one_byte_check and the recorded sha256 is carried so the attachment lane can verify in one step.
Nothing was fetched from any court host. Five targeted web lookups were used only to fix official identity and official URLs for documents established as absent.

classes.ATTACH_HELD_SOURCE: The artifact is held. The path, custody, sha256 and identity evidence are named so the attachment lane can bind it in one pass.
classes.ACQUIRE_EXACT_SOURCE: Genuinely not held. Exact official identity and issuing authority are established, with an exact official URL where one was fixed and an explicit urlKind and exactBinaryUrlEstablished flag where it was not.
classes.COMPOSE_FROM_AUTHORITY: No mandatory official fillable form exists. The authority prescribes the filing and the authority text is held. Left modelled as official_pdf_fill these families stay source-blocked forever.
classes.NON_PACKET_TREATMENT: The relief is not obtained by a participant-filed packet.
classes.EXACT_LEGAL_HOLD: One named legal-design question must be answered before any treatment is safe.

claimDiscipline: No packet-family claim was asserted or released. The claim ledger was not touched. No family was built, repaired or attached. No queue, verifier return or assignment file was written. No commercial route was opened and no family was promoted.

entries.why: The owner determined that all forms prescribed by Louisiana C.Cr.P. articles 987-995 and 998 use COMPOSE_FROM_AUTHORITY: article 986 makes the statutory articles themselves the prescribed forms, and the PDF renderings of 990 and 993 are reference renderings that create no separate source class. entries.howAbsenceWasEstablished: FABLE-CA1 hashed all 845 files in both mounted corpora — the Master Library and the D source packs — against the six digests pinned in SOURCE_RELATIONSHIP_REGISTRY.json. Zero matches. The state pack carries names and citations only (blankPdfInSource false, sourceFileName null for all eleven); the compiled profile carries no form text; the legal review describes structure rather than the prescribed wording.
entries.theOneHumanAction: Mount private/Nationwide Record Clearing/LegalEase Louisiana/forms/, or publish the six articles' print views into the D source packs in the shape already proven for 990, 993, 995, 998 and 999.1. Their digests are pinned, so arrival is verifiable without trusting the courier.

reconcilerOrderingDefect.what: scripts/grade-a-route-obligation-census/reconcile-census-source-custody.mjs resolveFormLabel() returns null at `if (labelTokens.length < 3) return null;` before it ever consults identityFindings, so the read-identity tier is unreachable for any census label carrying fewer than three tokens of more than two characters.
reconcilerOrderingDefect.whyItMatters: The three-token floor is documented as a guard on tier 2's token-subset matcher — it exists to stop a two-token label like CR-65 matching almost anything. Tier 3 does not use tokens at all: it keys on the exact normalised label and then requires the corpus index to hold the finding's exact path at its exact SHA-256. The floor therefore constrains a tier that does not need it.
